actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: README describes gym-px4 as an openai/gym environment for PX4 Gazebo SITL using MAVROS.
The package registers the Gym environment id px4-v0 with entry point gym_px4.envs:gymPX4.
The action space is a one-value Box whose low is 0.0 and high is 1.0.
The observation space is a two-value Box from [0.1, -3] to [25, 3].
The constructor creates publishers on /mavros/setpoint_position/local, /mavros/mocap/pose, /mavros/actuator_control, /mavros/setpoint_raw/attitude and /mavros/setpoint_attitude/thrust.

The constructor calls init_env, which initializes the anonymous ROS node gym_px4_mavros; it waits for the mavros/cmd/arming, mavros/set_mode and mavros/set_stream_rate services with no timeout argument, calls set_stream_rate for STREAM_POSITION and STREAM_ALL with the arguments 50 and 1, and calls offb_arm.
offb_arm calls set_mode with custom mode OFFBOARD and then the arming service with True, and checks neither response.
reset sets success_steps and steps to 0.

reset fixes desired and initial at 2 and then loops with no bound: it calls offb_arm whenever the stored state reports the vehicle disarmed, publishes the reset position with local_pos_pub and sleeps 0.5 s until the altitude error and the speed are below 0.2; it returns [desired - z, vz].
Before publishing, step loops with no bound and no sleep until the local-position z differs from the last stored z.

step sets a type mask that ignores the three body rates and the attitude, assigns the action to the attitude target's thrust, publishes it with setpoint_raw_pub, computes reward -(desired - z)^2, and returns the two-value observation, reward, done and info.
step sets done on |x| > 2, |y| > 2, z > 3 or z < 1 (reward -1000), on a step count above 5000, or when success_steps, incremented on every step with |desired - z| < 0.1, exceeds 50 (reward + 10000).
step creates rospy.Rate(20) when it starts.
step sleeps until 0.03 s have passed since it started and then calls rate.sleep().
README says to run Gazebo with the PX4 ROS wrappers and then roslaunch mavros px4.launch with fcu_url udp://:14540@127.0.0.1:14557.
README documents a four-value action space: thrust[0..1], roll[-1..1], pitch[-1..1], yaw[-1..1].
README documents gym.make('gym_px4:px4-v0'), env.reset() and env.step(action).

determinism.notes: The fake's transition is a fixed Python calculation with no random source. The bridge's seed endpoint records a seed for the next reset, but upstream reset uses fixed desired/initial values, so the seed has no effect and the same reset/step sequence is reproducible.

fidelity.engine: analytic:legacy-gym px4 altitude stand-in (no PX4, Gazebo or MAVROS)
gaps: the fake is a pure-Python stand-in: it loads no PX4 firmware, Gazebo, MAVROS, ROS, gym_px4 module or quadcopter model, and runs no physics, contacts, sensors, ROS graph or wall-clock loop

the fake keeps x and y at zero and models only vertical altitude and vertical velocity; the upstream observation is [desired - z, vz] and the README's wider observation description does not match the code's two-value Box (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:64-71)
the upstream action space defined by the code is a single thrust value (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:57-69), while README.md:57 documents thrust plus roll, pitch and yaw; the fake follows the code

the fake reset returns immediately, while the upstream reset publishes setpoints in an unbounded while-loop until the vehicle reaches the reset altitude (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:162-190); the upstream constructor also waits for MAVROS services and arms the vehicle (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:119-139)
the fake has no ROS publishers or services and cannot arm, switch to OFFBOARD, or command a real setpoint; it is evidence of the Gym contract only
the fake's thrust-to-velocity gain and step size are placeholders; its initial altitude mirrors the upstream fixed reset value only as test data, not as a fact or a limit
the seed capability is accepted by the bridge but does not change the deterministic fake or the upstream environment, whose reset uses fixed desired/initial values
the real backend path (gym.make(env_id)) was not run: it requires ROS 1 melodic, Gazebo 9, MAVROS, the legacy gym package and a running PX4 SITL, and the package is not installed in the gate
no upstream simulator, ROS graph or hardware was contacted, so this package is contract-checked on the fake only and makes no live-run or hardware claim

the upstream environment cannot tell PX4 SITL from a real vehicle: it arms and requests OFFBOARD on whatever flight controller MAVROS is connected to, without checking either response (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:294-311), and reset re-arms the vehicle whenever /mavros/state reports it disarmed, for example after a crash-landing disarm (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:164-165); only the README points MAVROS at the SITL port (README.md:30-31)

live construction in the server process would call the global rospy.init_node and wait for three MAVROS services with no timeout argument; the upstream step busy-waits with no bound or sleep until the local-position altitude changes (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:215-222), so a silent /mavros/local_position/pose blocks it forever; reset and step print progress lines and ANSI cursor-up sequences to standard output (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:155-192, 261-273), which would corrupt an MHS server speaking over stdio
the upstream observation [desired - z, vz] leaves its own observation Box, whose first lower bound is 0.1, whenever z > 2 (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:60-71, 252)
the upstream reset() takes no seed or options (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:143) and the fake's reset has the same signature, so the bridge falls back to a plain reset() for both

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: Software latch only: the runtime refuses every step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset and the fake stops advancing with its last observation readable; nothing upstream is called (gymPX4.close() does nothing), so nothing lands or disarms the quadcopter the constructor and reset armed in OFFBOARD, including a physical PX4 on the same MAVROS setpoints, and what PX4 does after those setpoints stop is outside this clone
